Senses.Explanation: An intensifying image of being utterly bare, exposed, or without covering or contrivance. Dawei Jinglun uses it in an authored discourse; Sanyi Mingyu, Yinyuan Longqi, and Zhangxue Tongzui use it in direct hall discourse or verse.
Senses.Note: Its surrounding syntax may make the phrase adjectival or adverbial, but the frozen evidence does not establish separate lexical senses.
